answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each new agent anchor its identity to a non-refundable external stake, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand real deposits rather than one. A fresh node joins as an isolated island with near-zero trust weight, earning attestation power only through audited work that peers can independently verify, so no swarm votes as an instant bloc. Reputation then behaves like karst bedrock: slow to build up, but one proven fraud dissolves a whole linked cluster through shared slashing, making sybil rings collapse together instead of profiting.
